name: ftlms-load-tests
description: k6 load testing for the FTLMS scheduler and campus-college-load flows, plus the Node scripts that seed/reset local test data.

scripts.loadtest:scheduler:matrix:rest: npm run mint-cookies && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run k6/scheduler-matrix.rest.js
scripts.loadtest:scheduler:matrix:rest:ramp: npm run ensure-results-dir && npm run clean-scheduler-matrix-ramp-output && npm run mint-cookies && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run --out json=results/scheduler-matrix-ramp.json k6/scheduler-matrix.rest.ramp.js || exit 0
scripts.loadtest:scheduler:session:rest: npm run seed:schedule-race && npm run mint-cookies && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run k6/scheduler-session.rest.js
scripts.loadtest:scheduler:session:rest:ramp: npm run ensure-results-dir && npm run clean-scheduler-session-ramp-output && npm run seed:schedule-race-pool && npm run mint-cookies && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run --out json=results/scheduler-session-ramp.json k6/scheduler-session.rest.ramp.js || exit 0
scripts.loadtest:scheduler:matrix:browser:repeat: npm run ensure-results-dir && npm run clean-scheduler-matrix-browser-repeat-output && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run --out json=results/scheduler-matrix-browser-repeat.json k6/scheduler-matrix.browser.repeat.js || exit 0
scripts.loadtest:scheduler:session:browser:repea: npm run ensure-results-dir && npm run clean-scheduler-session-browser-repeat-output && npm run seed:schedule-race-pool && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run --out json=results/scheduler-session-browser-repeat.json k6/scheduler-session.browser.repeat.js || exit 0
scripts.loadtest:ccl:rest: npm run reset && npm run seed:eval-batch && npm run mint-cookies && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run k6/campus-college-load.rest.js
scripts.loadtest:ccl:rest:ramp: npm run ensure-results-dir && npm run clean-ccl-ramp-output && npm run mint-cookies && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run --out json=results/ccl-ramp.json k6/campus-college-load.rest.ramp.js || exit 0
scripts.analyze:scheduler:matrix:browser:repeat: dotenv -e .env -- tsx scripts/analyze-repeat-results.ts results/scheduler-matrix-browser-repeat.json matrix_load_ms matrix_load_success || exit 0
scripts.analyze:scheduler:session:browser:repeat: dotenv -e .env -- tsx scripts/analyze-repeat-results.ts results/scheduler-session-browser-repeat.json session_write_ms session_write_success || exit 0
scripts.scheduler-load-test: npm run loadtest:scheduler:matrix:rest:ramp && npm run analyze:scheduler:matrix:ramp && npm run loadtest:scheduler:session:rest:ramp && npm run analyze:scheduler:session:ramp && npm run loadtest:scheduler:matrix:browser:repeat && npm run analyze:scheduler:matrix:browser:repeat && npm run loadtest:scheduler:session:browser:repeat && npm run analyze:scheduler:session:browser:repeat
scripts.ccl-load-test: npm run loadtest:ccl:rest:ramp && npm run analyze:ccl:ramp
scripts.load-tests: npm run scheduler-load-test && npm run ccl-load-test
